detection.mode_desc: Determines how the engine processes audio from multiple sources. Switches on the fly after Save.
detection.round_robin_desc: — one thread processes sources in turn. Lower peak CPU use.
detection.parallel_desc: — one inference thread per source. Sources processed simultaneously, can increase peak CPU use.
detection.interval_desc: Time between model passes for each audio source. Larger values reduce CPU load but delay detections and may miss shorter sounds.
threshold.desc: Minimum confidence score for each sound type. When MLP classifier is active (siren), this applies to the MLP output score.
threshold.siren_desc: MLP confidence score required for each siren detection to count as a trigger. Lower = more sensitive but more false positives.
dsp_setting.desc: Lightweight Conv1D model that skips YAMNet when confident about background, saving CPU.
dsp_setting.enabled_desc: When On, lightweight DSP classifier pre-screens audio before YAMNet. Confident background is skipped, reducing CPU load up to 90%. Disable to always run full YAMNet inference.
click.desc: Suppresses impulse noise (clicks, pops) from INMP441 before inference. Prevents false "Explosion" detections from electrical interference.

tip.detection_mode:
Detection Mode
Determines how the engine processes audio from multiple sources. Switches on the fly after Save.
Round Robin — one thread processes sources in turn. Lower peak CPU use.

Parallel — one inference thread per source. Sources are processed simultaneously, which can increase peak CPU use.
Default: round_robin
tip.inference_interval_seconds:
Inference Interval
Time between model passes for each audio source. Larger values reduce CPU load but can delay detections or miss shorter sounds.
Range: 0.25 – 2.0 sec
Default: 0.5
tip.siren_threshold:
Siren Threshold
MLP confidence score required for a siren detection to count as a trigger. Lower = more sensitive but more false positives.
Range: 0.0 – 1.0
Default: 0.10
tip.explosion_threshold:
Explosion Threshold
YAMNet confidence for explosion/gunshot/burst. Classes: Explosion, Burst pop, Gunshot gunfire.
Range: 0.0 – 1.0
Default: 0.15
tip.uav_threshold:
UAVs Threshold
YAMNet confidence for UAV engine sounds.
Range: 0.0 – 1.0
Default: 0.15
tip.dsp_enabled:
DSP Pre-filter
When On, a lightweight DSP classifier pre-screens audio before YAMNet. Confident background is skipped, reducing CPU load by up to 90%. Disable to always run full YAMNet inference.
Default: On
tip.dsp_bg_threshold:
DSP Background Threshold
Minimum DSP confidence to skip YAMNet. Higher = more conservative (fewer skips, less risk of missing events). Lower = more aggressive (more skips, saves more CPU).
Range: 0.50 – 1.00
Default: 0.85
tip.dsp_bg_release_threshold:
DSP Background Release Threshold
While DSP is skipping YAMNet, it resumes YAMNet when background confidence drops below this value. Higher values release background sooner; lower values keep skipping longer.
Range: 0.50 – 1.00
Default: 0.85
tip.dsp_bg_confirm_windows:
DSP Background Confirm Windows
Number of consecutive confident background predictions required before DSP starts skipping YAMNet. Higher values prevent it from returning to background too quickly but run YAMNet more often.
Range: 1 – 10 windows
Default: 2
tip.dsp_event_gate:
DSP Event Gate
If any event class (siren, explosion, uav) has DSP probability above this threshold, always run YAMNet even if background confidence is high. Lower = more sensitive, catches quieter events. Set to 0 to disable.
Range: 0.00 – 0.50
Default: 0.08
tip.dsp_max_consecutive_skips:
DSP Max Consecutive Skips
After this many consecutive DSP skips for a source, force one YAMNet pass. Low values (3-5) let YAMNet catch events quickly despite DSP's slow 5s window. Higher values save more CPU but delay detection. Set to 0 to disable.
Range: 0 – 200
Default: 4 (~2 seconds)
tip.click_removal_enabled:
Click Removal
When On, detects impulse noise (1-5 sample spikes from electrical interference) and replaces them with interpolated values before YAMNet inference. Real explosions span hundreds of samples and are not affected.
Default: On
tip.click_removal_threshold:
Click Removal Threshold
How many median absolute deviations a sample must exceed to be classified as a click. Lower = more aggressive removal (may clip loud sounds). Higher = only catches extreme spikes.
Range: 3.0 – 50.0
Default: 10.0
tip.click_removal_max_width:
Max Click Width
Maximum number of consecutive outlier samples to treat as a click. Groups longer than this are left untouched (likely real audio). INMP441 clicks are typically 1-5 samples.
Range: 1 – 20 samples
Default: 5
tip.yamnet_min_gate:
YAMNet Min Gate
YAMNet must show at least this score for the MLP result to be trusted. Prevents MLP hallucinations on unfamiliar audio. Set to 0 to fully trust MLP.
Range: 0.0 – 1.0
Default: 0.01
tip.possible_triggers:
Possible Triggers
Windows needed for early warning (yellow badge). No clip saved yet.
Range: 1 – 60
Default: 4
tip.confirmed_triggers:
Confirmed Triggers
Windows needed to confirm event. Saves clip, sends MQTT. Must be > possible triggers.
Range: 1 – 60
Default: 8
tip.smoothing_window_seconds:
Smoothing Window
Rolling time window for trigger accumulation. 30s window at 0.5s inference = up to 61 slots.
Range: 5 – 120 sec
Default: 30
tip.cooldown_seconds:
Cooldown
After confirmed event, ignore detections for this long. Prevents duplicate events. 0 = no cooldown.
Range: 0 – 600 sec
Default: 60
tip.refractory_seconds:
Refractory
After cooldown, wait for score to drop before re-arming. If score stays high, expires by timeout. 0 = disabled.
Range: 0 – 120 sec
Default: 15
tip.clip_seconds:
Clip Length
Duration of saved audio clip. Shorter = less noise for retraining.
Range: 5 – 60 sec
Default: 10
tip.clip_from_possible:
Clip From Possible
When On, clip captures from the moment event reaches "possible" (+ 2s pre-buffer) instead of last N seconds before "confirmed". Includes per-window scores in metadata.
Default: Off
tip.user_event_clip_seconds:
User Event Clip Length
Duration saved when you create an event manually.
Range: 5 – 60 sec
Default: 15
tip.save_background_segments:
Save Background Segments
When audio segments are labeled, save the remaining unmarked parts as background training data.
Default: Off
gate.desc: Controls when to trust the MLP classifier for siren detection.
smoothing.desc: How many above-threshold inference windows are needed to change detection state.
clips.desc: Saved when an event is confirmed. Used for review and retraining.
source.desc: Enable or disable detection for each microphone. Disabled sources still receive audio (available for calibration) but their events are discarded. DSP and Click Removal settings inherit the global defaults unless you add a source override.
engine.default_route_desc: This route applies to sources without a specific rule.
engine.source_route_desc: Each source rule replaces the default list completely.
source.dsp_desc: Choose whether this microphone uses the global DSP settings or its own override. Source overrides take effect after saving.
source.dsp_enabled_desc: When on, the lightweight DSP classifier pre-screens audio before YAMNet. Confident background is skipped to reduce CPU use; turn it off to always run full inference.
source.bg_threshold_desc: Minimum DSP confidence needed to skip YAMNet. Higher values skip less often and are more conservative; lower values save more CPU but may miss events.
source.bg_release_desc: While YAMNet is skipped, it resumes when background confidence drops below this value. Higher values resume sooner; lower values keep skipping longer.
source.bg_windows_desc: Consecutive background predictions required before DSP starts skipping YAMNet. Higher values add caution but reduce CPU savings.
source.event_gate_desc: If a siren, explosion, or UAV probability exceeds this value, YAMNet runs even when background confidence is high. Lower values are more sensitive. Set to 0 to disable.
source.max_skips_desc: After this many consecutive DSP skips, force one YAMNet pass. Lower values catch events sooner; higher values save more CPU. Set to 0 to disable.
source.click_desc: Choose whether this microphone uses the global click removal settings or its own override. Threshold controls click detection sensitivity; max width limits the duration of clicks that are removed. Source overrides take effect after saving.
source.click_enabled_desc: Detect impulse noise such as electrical clicks and replace spikes with interpolated audio before inference.
source.click_threshold_desc: How far a sample must exceed the local median absolute deviation to count as a click. Lower removes more spikes but may clip loud sounds; higher catches only extreme spikes.
source.click_width_desc: Longest impulse, in samples, that can be removed. Wider sounds are left intact.
